name: game-hud
description: 8-bit HUD above the prompt: HP = context left, MP = plan usage left, G = session cost, with rest and save buttons when HP runs low

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off hides the band; casual draws LV/HP/MP/G and the low-HP row; hardcore adds EXP and the turn count

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)

lowHp.title: Low HP (%)
lowHp.description: Show the rest/save row and a toast when context left drops to this percent

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: usd shows the cost ledger as kept; krw converts it with krwPerUsd

krwPerUsd.title: KRW per USD
krwPerUsd.description: Rate used when currency is krw
